world.title: Iran currency plunges to record low as US dollar breaks 2 million rials on open market
world.summary: The Iranian rial reached a record low on Sunday, with the US dollar exceeding 2 million rials in the open market. This decline exacerbates the economic difficulties faced by Iranians as the country anticipates further US sanctions. Diplomatic relations with Washington remain stagnant, contributing to the ongoing financial instability and uncertainty within Iran's economy.

world.title: Iran invited to join Mecca pact by Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Pakistan: Report
world.summary: Iran has received an invitation to join the Mecca Agreement for Mutual Defense, a newly established security alliance comprising Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan, according to Al Mayadeen. The invitation's status remains unconfirmed, highlighting potential shifts in regional dynamics. The alliance aims to enhance mutual defense cooperation among its member states in the Middle East.

world.title: Wash rice twice, not 7 times: Drought-hit England targets faith, cultural habits
world.summary: England's water crisis has led to a £270,000 campaign encouraging residents to wash rice only twice instead of seven times and to use a one-litre jug for wudu instead of a running tap. The initiative aims to promote water conservation amid drought conditions, targeting cultural habits to reduce water usage in daily practices.

business.title: Stocks in news: Reliance Industries, Bank of Baroda, Power Grid, NATCO Pharma and JSW Infra
business.summary: Indian equity markets ended mostly flat on August 21, following a volatile session. Key corporate developments were reported by Reliance Industries and Bank of Baroda. Power Grid Corporation and Jubilant Pharmova secured important project wins and regulatory approvals. NATCO Pharma and Caplin Point Laboratories received US FDA observations. Mobile manufacturing stocks may attract attention due to a new government scheme.

business.title: Sebi turns down Adani-linked FPIs' settlement applications
business.summary: Sebi has rejected settlement applications from foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) linked to Adani, as communicated to their representatives last week. This decision revives an investigation initiated in October 2020, when Sebi's surveillance systems identified unusual concentration in their holdings. The investigation flagged 13 FPIs, which subsequently sought to resolve the matter through settlement applications.

business.title: The $100-mn West Asia nightmare giving sleepless nights to HDFC Bank's NRI customers
business.summary: HDFC Bank is facing complaints from NRI customers regarding a financial product that raised $100 million, marking a recurring issue in West Asia. Investor Umesh Kumar Chandanani, a retired banker in Australia, reported being approached by his relationship manager in 2019 about the investment. The product involves the Luxembourg Life Fund managed by Carlisle Asset Management.

technology.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta Steam player count falls by 65% amid mixed reviews
technology.summary: Interest in the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta declined significantly during its first weekend, with Steam player counts dropping from 115,145 to under 38,000. Players reported various issues, including performance drawbacks and concerns over unfair aim-assist. Mixed reviews on Valve’s site reflect these problems, raising questions about the game's potential success following the previous title's struggles.

technology.title: phone hybrid could be the future of Linux smartphones
technology.summary: A new hybrid device aims to combine the functionality of a Linux computer with the portability of a smartphone. This innovation allows users to carry a Linux system in their pocket, complete with typing capabilities. While the software landscape for Linux is thriving, the hardware options remain limited, highlighting a potential shift in the Linux smartphone market.

technology.title: NVIDIA GeForce On returns August 25, DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction release expected
technology.summary: NVIDIA will host its Gamescom 2026 GeForce On update on August 25 at 8 AM PT (17:00 CEST), streaming on YouTube and Twitch. The event is expected to feature discussions on DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction, following the discovery of related files in Modern Warfare 4. Further details on upcoming updates and features are anticipated during the presentation.

sports.title: Details, Premier League transfer news
sports.summary: Manchester City has reportedly reached an agreement with Lille to sign 18-year-old Moroccan player Ayyoub Bouaddi. The deal, valued at approximately $163 million AUD, marks a significant move for the Premier League club as they aim to strengthen their squad. Bouaddi is considered a rising talent in football, attracting attention from top clubs across Europe.

sports.title: Manchester City yields to Chelsea's demands
sports.summary: Manchester City is set to pursue Argentine midfielder Enzo Fernandez from Chelsea as the summer transfer window nears its end. The club has indicated a willingness to meet Chelsea's high financial demands for the player. Reports suggest that City views Fernandez as a key target and is prepared to make a significant offer to secure his transfer.

sports.title: New manager, same old Liverpool: Florian Wirtz and Alexander Isak's dreadful displays in lucky draw at Newcastle suggest Andoni Iraola might have even more problems than Arne Slot!
sports.summary: Liverpool drew 2-2 against Newcastle in their Premier League opener, with Florian Wirtz and Alexander Isak underperforming. Despite a new manager, Andoni Iraola, the team's weaknesses from last season persisted, as noted by Pat Nevin on BBC Radio 5 Live. The match highlighted ongoing issues in Liverpool's midfield, raising concerns about Iraola's ability to address these problems effectively.

health.title: Indian labs are innovating cancer care
health.summary: Indian researchers are utilizing artificial intelligence to improve cancer treatment by focusing on stem-like cells. This approach aims to minimize harm to healthy tissues while effectively targeting cancer cells, which can adapt and evade treatment. By enhancing detection methods, these innovations seek to address the challenges posed by cancer's ability to disguise itself and resist conventional therapies.

health.title: In a recent study, University of Freiburg researchers coated Colombian water tanks for about $2 a year. Weeks later, dengue cases fell, showing one application could provide long-term protection again
health.summary: Researchers from the University of Freiburg developed a cost-effective coating for Colombian water tanks, costing about $2 annually. This treatment significantly reduced dengue cases by 45% within weeks and remains effective for over twelve months. The study highlights the coating's potential for long-term mosquito control, applicable in both Colombia and Europe, targeting mosquito breeding sites effectively.

health.title: Heat diseases flood city clinics after late-monsoon warm spell
health.summary: Kolkata clinics are experiencing a surge in heat-related illnesses, including heat exhaustion, dehydration, and dizziness, due to an unusual late-monsoon warm spell reaching nearly 34°C. Patients are reporting symptoms such as nausea and blackouts, which are atypical for this season. Additionally, there are increased cases of viral and respiratory infections coinciding with the heat wave.

science.title: China abruptly postpones ambitious Chang'e-7 lunar mission launch
science.summary: China has postponed the Chang'e-7 lunar mission, originally scheduled for launch, due to unmet conditions and a focus on ensuring mission success. The mission aimed to explore the moon, including searching for water ice. The announcement was made on August 23, 2026, highlighting the country's commitment to thorough preparation before proceeding with the ambitious lunar exploration project.

science.title: Birds Are Living Dinosaurs: Gastrolith Wear Patterns Reveal the Secrets of Evolution
science.summary: A study by Japanese and South Korean scientists reveals that gastrolith (stomach stone) wear patterns provide insights into the evolution of dinosaurs into birds. The analysis indicates that changes in the digestive system were crucial, particularly in dinosaurs that lost their teeth. This research enhances understanding of the evolutionary transition from dinosaurs to modern birds.

science.title: A 150-Million-Year-Old Dinosaur Flight Mystery May Finally Have an Answer
science.summary: Researchers suggest that Archaeopteryx, a 150-million-year-old dinosaur, may have achieved sustained flight by executing two or three powerful leaps to gain the necessary speed. Its wing structure, which lacked the ability to lift high above its back and a keeled breastbone for modern-style launches, posed challenges for takeoff. This new insight sheds light on its flight capabilities.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: August 24, 2026
entertainment.summary: On August 24, 2026, horoscopes emphasize the importance of holistic health for Pisces. Key recommendations include maintaining a balanced diet, consuming beneficial content, staying hydrated, ensuring adequate sleep, engaging in light exercise, and enjoying morning sunlight. Following these guidelines is suggested to enhance overall well-being, addressing mental, emotional, physical, and spiritual aspects of health.

entertainment.title: Aries Horoscope Today: August 24, 2026
entertainment.summary: Aries individuals are encouraged to incorporate Feng Shui into their lives as Virgo season approaches. This week may involve addressing unfinished tasks and finding balance in mind, body, and soul. As the eclipse window closes, Aries may feel a sense of urgency to complete these tasks. It’s a time for reflection and organization in various aspects of life.

By following these guidelines, individuals can enhance their overall well-being and maintain a balanced lifestyle. Focus on self-care is essential for personal growth and fulfillment.
